subject: Re: OEM Core Switching Solution
text:
Hi, IIdar,
Please see attached software list.
Our switch supports standard BGP (Border Gateway Protocol), including both
eBGP and iBGP.
It supports IPv4 and IPv6 unicast address families, with flexible routing
policy control such as prefix-list, route-map, AS-path and community.
1, Could you please confirm whether this meets your requirements?
2, Please let us know if you have any specific BGP features or deployment
scenarios in mind.
Thank you.
note: SC-189 Ildar Salimov（私邮）：问 BGP；Elsa 2026-01-20 答 CENTEC 线支持 eBGP/iBGP、IPv4/IPv6、prefix-list/route-map（这是 CENTEC 核心机口径，不是 AC5）
